pricing.peak_window: UTC+8 weekdays 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00; original conservative holiday treatment
pricing.source: Recorded study protocols and usage-estimate implementation; not current-price rebilling

scope: Token-based estimates for logged cohorts, including technical retries. Not account billing or project-wide expenditure. Excludes unlogged exploratory runs, Study-A usage and server rental.
time_definition: API-active time is the sum of recorded request durations per planned run. Batch wall time is earliest request start to latest finish, with concurrent execution. Includes known technical attempts; excludes docking and GIN training.
